title: fix(study): the position pills grow without limit at the largest text size
body:
At the largest system text size, the position pills on Study (All, GK, DF, MF, FW) in `components/FilterPill.tsx` scale with the text and have no cap, unlike the Hide names label and the kind tabs, which set `maxFontSizeMultiplier`. The filter row takes up too much of the screen.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The pills stay a sensible height at the largest system text size, in both themes
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
source: synthetic; replaced 2026-10-24 (twice): the main pin has no ThemeToggle, and AppearanceControl already shrinks its labels; FilterPill has no maxFontSizeMultiplier at the pin
why: No Size on the board or in the body: the skill estimates one, says so, and proceeds.
